name: The Storm Herald
notes: L11-B1 (drafts/planning/L11-SPEC.md section 3): belt 9 Guardian, built only from Hearth Cook parts (two counterable circles, one dash-only lane, two helpers at two-thirds health). Base 495/17/30 like the Floor Keeper. Name, intro, freed and lore come from drafts/content/bosses/storm-herald.json and bestiary-plan.json. PLACEHOLDER: the phase tells, sensei lines, attack note, tip and description wait for L11-C2.

phases.tell: A striped lane and double marks.

lines.intro: The storm is so loud. Can you hear the calm?
lines.freed: The wind is still. Listen. Someone is calling from the top.
lines.senseiAfter: You stayed steady inside the storm.

description: The Storm Herald makes red circles, calls swarmers, then sends a striped lane.

bestiary.tip: Counter the circles. Dash the stripes.

lore.brown-black: A tall figure of wind and lightning. It shouts the storm louder so no one hears the calm. Free it, and its light comes home.
